summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI client). Wrote permanent guard tests and the pinned migration contract/delta analysis; no implementation changes, per phase rules. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so the Swift tests were not executed locally; they run via `swift test` on macOS CI and are red by design until the implementation run lands. Research against viamin/color_matching@main (issue #110, merged) verified the exact published operationIds, schemas, and paths used by the tests.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document fetched/vendored from viamin/color_matching#110
acceptance_criteria.reason: Implementation phase pending (tests-only run; Package.swift and Sources/ are outside permitted paths). Permanent guard test is in place to verify this the moment the spec is vendored.

references.note: testVendoredSpecCoversEveryCompanionEndpoint fails today because iOS/Sources/OpenAPIGenerated/openapi.json does not exist yet; it asserts all six endpoint paths, verbs, and published operationIds after vendoring.

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results
acceptance_criteria.reason: Implementation phase pending. One stubbed-response test per surface is written and compile-gated on the generated module.

references.note: Gated on #if canImport(OpenAPIGenerated) && canImport(OpenAPIRuntime) && canImport(HTTPTypes); until then the #else placeholder at line 310 fails with a pointer to the pinned contract. Covers all six surfaces: manifest (line 19), recent (line 61), capture creation (line 94), measurements (line 138), judgments (line 190), ranked results (line 225), plus the 404 error case (line 48).

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models
acceptance_criteria.reason: Implementation-phase criterion (sources outside permitted test/doc paths in this run). Existing APIClientTests remain green in the interim.

references.note: Current hand-written client coverage; to be superseded by the generated-client tests when the replacement lands.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)
acceptance_criteria.reason: Tests are written and committed at this PR head, but no Swift toolchain exists in this container so they were not executed locally; CI `swift test` (macOS) runs them. Expected state at this head: red (canImport placeholder fails; vendored-spec guards fail), demonstrating the missing behavior per the red-phase rules.

references.note: Seven tests using an in-process RecordingStubTransport (no network, no live server): request method/path/operationId/content-type and wire-shape assertions, decoded response assertions including versioned enums (lpsSheetManifestV1, lpsDistanceV1, lpsRankedResultsV1), nullable title decoding, and upload count responses.
Compatibility version strings and bearerAuth security scheme pinned in the vendored spec.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records what changed between the prose contract and the published spec, plus endpoint gaps
acceptance_criteria.reason: Delta analysis and endpoint-gap findings are recorded in an inspectable document committed at this head, ready to be carried into the PR description verbatim.

references.note: 'Contract deltas: prose contract vs published spec' section (manifest schema only pins 3 fields; lps-ranked-results/v1 is new; CaptureRequest anyOf flat vs nested with exposure_duration name mismatch; top-level scoring_algorithm_version removed; per-measurement stats absent; RgbPayload three wire forms; normalized median required; uploads now return JSON count bodies; iso is integer) plus the 'Endpoint coverage' section (no gaps for the six surfaces; extra unused endpoints listed). Sources: viamin/color_matching@main api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, router.ex.
